note: The fair iso-COMPUTE batch test, which a12/a13 did not give me. Those two were iso-token (35M each) but took 1603s and 1301s -- the big batch is 33% faster, so at a fixed compute budget it earns 33% more tokens. This gives 122,880 exactly that: 46.6M tokens, which fills the same 1202s of training a12 used. If TGT lands below a12's 4.7263 the larger, faster batch wins on the axis production actually cares about, and the recommendation changes. This is the same iso-token-vs-iso-compute distinction that turned doc-mask from a win into a loss.
